metadata.description: Example Claude Code mods from the claude-code-kit library

plugins.name: context-meter
plugins.description: Band above the prompt: context fill, cache read, cost, plan limits; warns at 50%/70%; Handoff button and /handoff past 70%.

plugins.name: lang-guard
plugins.description: Example language guard: flags Russian words and plain-language slips in Bulgarian answers and reminds Claude. Adapt the word lists to your language.

plugins.name: ci-watch
plugins.description: /ci-watch <pr>: polls gh pr checks every minute in the status line, no tokens.

plugins.name: cleanup-tracker
plugins.description: Records downloads, installs and started containers; /cleanup-list shows them.

plugins.name: subagent-models
plugins.description: Pins subagent models to a model-routing policy (Opus for judgement, Haiku for mechanical work, Sonnet otherwise) and logs every spawn.

plugins.name: fleet-status
plugins.description: P1/P2 counts from a triage report file (option state_file) in the status line; /fleet and /ports commands.

plugins.name: secret-redactor
plugins.description: Hides tokens, keys and passwords in tool output as ‹secret:N›, restores them in later tool calls, blocks reading key files.

plugins.name: ssh-guard
plugins.description: Refuses ssh/scp/rsync to hosts listed in a retired-hosts file (option hosts_file); "# decommissioned-ok" overrides.

plugins.name: cache-guard
plugins.description: Keeps the prompt cache warm while idle and holds the first prompt after the cache went cold, with its cost.

plugins.name: spend-ledger
plugins.description: Per-project token and cost ledger per machine; /spend; optional monthly note in a Svod-compatible notes MCP, other machines pulled over ssh.

plugins.name: aside
plugins.description: /aside <question>: asks a tool-less fork of the session in a pane; nothing enters the main conversation.

plugins.name: deploy-verify
plugins.description: After a deploy command, runs 5 post-deploy checks from the project's .claude/deploy-verify.json and tells Claude the result.

plugins.name: company-hq
plugins.description: Back office for the /company skill: every /company run is its own company (state file per company, several open at once), hires project specialists as agent types, enforces each company's budget cap on every spawn, shows the org and spend in a pane.
